title: Follows your folder
changes: The panel shows the todos of the folder you're working in, even after a cd
It switches on its own within a minute, never while you're typing or dragging

title: Colourful lists
changes: Click a list's dot to change its colour
Delete a whole list with its todos from the dot's menu; Ctrl+Z undoes
Drag a list by its dot as well as its name
Unticked todos go back to the list they came from
A README with install steps, a cheat sheet and a demo

title: Faster capture
changes: "+ New list" sits at the top, next to quick add, always in view
Press n for a new todo below the selected one, l for a new list
Long quick-add text scrolls sideways instead of running off the panel
Click inside the quick-add text to place the cursor there
Emoji and CJK text wrap and line up correctly
Fixed a click after an unnamed new list ticking the wrong todo

title: Panel that remembers
changes: Drag a list's title to reorder your lists
Theme and collapsed lists are remembered for each TODOS.md
The panel restarts itself on a new build, keeping undo and selection
Press r to reload TODOS.md when outside edits don't show up
Click empty space or press Esc to clear the selection
Fixed dragging a list to the end when there's no Done list

title: Lists from the panel
changes: Reads hand-written TODOS.md files: any heading level, plain bullets, continued lines
Create, rename and remove lists right from the panel
Collapse a whole list from the marker on its title
Delete a selected todo with its sub-items; Ctrl+Z brings it back
Wheel scrolling no longer snaps back; wrapped todos stay fully visible
Fixed clicks landing on the wrong row after renaming or adding a list

title: First usable todos panel
changes: Todo lists from a TODOS.md file in a small herdr side panel
Click a todo to write in it; Return starts the next one
Drag todos to reorder them or move them between lists
Click the box to tick a todo; it moves to Done
Sub-items with Tab, indent guides, and collapsible groups
Long todos wrap; outside edits to TODOS.md show up live
Undo and redo with Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, mac-style text keys
Optional green phosphor look, toggled with t
